title: Strong and silent
text: Strong and silent. Since this mattress protector is waterproof and encases the mattress, I only need 1.  In the past, I’ve used 2 lower quality pads, and this pad is better quality.

product_metadata.title: Full Size Waterproof Bamboo Mattress Encasement by Slumberfy - Premium Skin-Safe Mattress Protector with 360° EZ Zipper, Lab-Tested Bed Bug, Zippered Mattress Encasement (54x75 in)
features: WATERPROOF MATTRESS ENCASEMENT: Slumberfy has developed a premium Waterproof Mattress Protector Encasement, with a focus on keeping your family’s mattresses safe from bed bugs and dust mites, as well as liquid spills, sweat, dirt, dust and unhealthy allergens that may be lurking in their mattress. Less dust and dirt in your mattress equal a better night’s sleep, every time!

360° EZ ZIPPER: Slumberfy’s innovative zip off mattress cover is super easy to install or remove and makes laundering breeze. An easy grip zipper is placed around the entire top of the encasement, so the whole cover can be taken on or off in 60 seconds or less!

PREMIUM PROTECTION: Our ultra-breathable bamboo mattress encasement bed bug proof fabric completely surrounds, protects and seals the mattress on all 6 sides, so your mattress is entirely sealed in and out. All-natural hypoallergenic fabric is completely silent, with none of the crinkling sounds you get with a typical mattress protector. Enjoy a sleep experience you simply cannot get anywhere else.

FEATURES & BENEFITS: Using Circular technology, our natural bamboo fabric is super-breathable so it can promote airflow. Breathe easy equals sleep easy. It’s that simple! Slumberfy’s bed/mattress protector is available in the following sizes: Twin, Twin XL, Full, Queen, King and Cal King.

LIFETIME WARRANTY: At Slumberfy, we strive to provide a clean, healthy and comfortable sleep environment. We believe a healthy family starts with a healthy sleep. Slumberfy pledges to help you keep your family’s mattresses safe and protected for a wonderful night’s sleep, filled with sweet dreams. We’re so sure you’ll love our products; we offer a Lifetime Warranty!

details.Fabric Type: Top Fabric 100% Bamboo / Bottom Fabric 100% Polyester
